short.en: We can build a castle out of blocks today.
short.zh: 我们今天可以用积木搭一座城堡。
short.note: build a 连读；castle 的 /t/ 不发音；blocks 尾音 /ks/。

short.en: What time does the last train leave tonight?
short.zh: 今晚最后一班火车几点开？
short.note: last train 连读；tonight 重音在后。

short.en: The purchase has sparked outrage over its cost as many Ghanaians struggle with rising cost of living.
short.zh: 由于许多加纳人正在努力应对不断上涨的生活成本，此次购买引发了对其成本的愤怒。

short.en: I didn't see you at the party last night.
short.zh: 昨晚派对上我没看到你。
short.note: didn't 的 /t/ 可失爆；party 重音在前。

short.en: That sounds like a really good plan to me.
short.zh: 我觉得这计划听起来挺不错。
short.note: sounds like 连读；plan to 中 t 弱读。

short.en: India will remain predominantly Hindu, though its Muslim population is projected to grow faster, according to a new survey.
short.zh: 根据一项新的调查，印度仍将以印度教徒为主，尽管其穆斯林人口预计增长更快。

short.en: Cold War: In Geneva, U.S. President Ronald Reagan and Soviet Union General Secretary Mikhail Gorbachev meet for the first time.
short.zh: 冷战：在日内瓦，美国总统罗纳德·里根和苏联总书记米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫首次会面。

short.en: You owe me big time for this one.
short.zh: 这次你可欠我大人情了。
short.note: owe 双元音 /oʊ/；big time 作短语表“大大地”。

short.en: The first smartphone, the IBM Simon, is introduced at COMDEX in Las Vegas, Nevada.
short.zh: 第一款智能手机IBM Simon在内华达州拉斯维加斯的COMDEX上亮相。

short.en: The stars twinkled like tiny lights in the sky.
short.zh: 星星像天空中的小光点一样闪烁。
short.note: twinkled 中 /tw/；stars 的 /ts/；sky 双元音 /aɪ/。

short.en: Following a hostage siege, at least 19 people are killed in Bamako, Mali.
If you can't make it good, at least make it look good.
When you want something in life, you just gotta reach out and grab it.
A mountain never yields to the wind no matter how strong it is.
Thomas Edison announces his invention of the phonograph, a machine that can record and play sound.
In Washington, D.C., the FBI Scientific Crime Detection Laboratory (better known as the FBI Crime Lab) officially opens.
short.zh: 在华盛顿特区，联邦调查局科学犯罪侦查实验室（更广为人知的名称是联邦调查局犯罪实验室）正式开业。

short.en: We should leave early if we don't want to miss the last bus.
short.zh: 要是不想错过末班车，我们得早点出发。
short.note: miss 错过；last bus 末班车。

short.en: When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth.
short.zh: 排除一切不可能之后，剩下的无论多么不可思议，必定就是真相。
short.note: impossible 与 improbable 对比；长句在逗号处换气。

short.en: Johan Alfred Ander becomes the last person to be executed in Sweden.
short.zh: 约翰·阿尔弗雷德·安德成为瑞典被处决的最后一个人。

short.en: We are all here for some special reason.

long.en: World War II: Cairo Conference: U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill, and Chinese Premier Chiang Kai-shek meet in Cairo, Egypt, to discuss ways to defeat Japan.
long.zh: 第二次世界大战：开罗会议：美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福、英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔和中国总理蒋介石在埃及开罗举行会议，讨论击败日本的方法。

long.en: Apollo program: Apollo 12 astronauts Pete Conrad and Alan Bean land at Oceanus Procellarum (the "Ocean of Storms") and become the third and fourth humans to walk on the Moon.
long.zh: 阿波罗计划：阿波罗 12 号宇航员皮特·康拉德和艾伦·比恩登陆 Oceanus Procellarum（“风暴之海”），成为第三和第四位登上月球的人类。

long.en: Phones make it easy to stay in touch, but they can also take our attention away from the people sitting right in front of us. Setting aside some screen-free time each evening helps us rest and talk more openly with one another.
long.zh: 手机让保持联系变得容易，但也会把我们的注意力从眼前的人身上移开。每晚留出一段不看屏幕的时间，能帮我们休息，也让彼此聊得更坦诚。
long.note: take attention away from 分散注意；screen-free 复合形容词；openly 副词。

words.z: n. 外科医生, 军医, 船医
a. 艺术的, 艺术家的, 富有艺术性的
n. 读写能力, 识字, 精通文学
n. 国库, 宝库, 财政部, 国库券
a. 天资高的, 有才能的
n. 王冠, 王权, 顶点
a. 赤裸的, 缺少的, 无遮蔽的, 坦率的
